joint_instances: N complete se_round calls, all submitted at time zero
hardware: unchanged single flexible transport AOD; original unlimited row/column/readout counts
timing: standard/2: measurement100, processing0, LOAD10, STORE10 us; other reference values unchanged
geometry: unchanged: factories top-to-bottom below y=0; readout y>=50um
implementation: one combined source DAG, one compile_physical call, existing NonZonedStrategy and ReadyScheduler
controls: joint: only source-local dependencies and barriers
serial: same sources with explicit cross-instance barriers
solo i: one selected factory at its actual position, identical complete world

decomposition.slowest_index: one argmax over total solo durations; deterministic smallest-index tie break
decomposition.phase_effects: apply both differences using the same slowest_index in every exclusive phase
decomposition.interpretation: net joint effect includes resource constraints, batching, changed joint destinations and scheduler choices; not a pure contention estimate or a physical lower bound

evidence: exact source/measurement ownership and no cross-instance DAG edges in joint mode
all joint sources ready at zero with one global physical clock
real multi-owner gate actions and transport batches, excluding spectator illumination as concurrency evidence
time partition, transport batch structure, distances and readout destinations
native-DAG semantic validation and exact return-home replay
